body.purpose: Root interface text and app names.

motion.name: dialog-in
motion.purpose: Opacity .5, translate(-50%,-48%), scale(.985) to centered rest.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, animations and transitions use .01ms, one animation iteration, and scroll-behavior:auto.

components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-button-primary { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size:12px; min-height:33px; padding:6px 13px; border:0; border-radius:7px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:7px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:background 150ms,transform 180ms var(--ease),box-shadow 150ms; color:var(--surface); background:var(--accent); }.ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--accent-hover); }.ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }.ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity:.48; cursor:default; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition-duration:.01ms; } }

components.name: Text field
components.html: <input class="ds-field" aria-label="Repository URL" placeholder="Paste a GitHub link">
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size:12px; color:var(--text); background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:7px; padding:8px 10px; caret-color:var(--accent); } .ds-field::placeholder { color:var(--tertiary); opacity:1; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Settings switch
components.description: Native-like boolean preference with a visible label.
components.html: <label class="ds-switch-label">Check for updates<input class="ds-switch" type="checkbox" role="switch" checked></label>
components.css: .ds-switch-label { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size:12px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:22px; color:var(--text); } .ds-switch { appearance:none; width:34px; height:20px; padding:0; margin:0; border:0; border-radius:12px; background:var(--hover); position:relative; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms var(--ease); } .ds-switch::before { content:""; position:absolute; width:16px; height:16px; left:2px; top:2px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--surface); box-shadow:0 1px 3px #0003; transition:transform 180ms var(--spring); } .ds-switch:checked { background:var(--accent); } .ds-switch:checked::before { transform:translateX(14px); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-switch:disabled { opacity:.48; cursor:default; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-switch,.ds-switch::before { transition-duration:.01ms; } }

components.name: Managed versions summary
components.description: Compact flat storage amount with a refresh action.
components.html: Managed versions0 B
components.css: .ds-storage { font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:12px 0 20px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:13px; line-height:1.45; color:var(--secondary); } .ds-storage strong { font-size:13px; font-weight:500; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:var(--text); } .ds-storage-refresh { margin-left:auto; border:0; background:none; width:30px; height:30px; border-radius:6px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; color:var(--secondary); cursor:pointer; } .ds-storage-refresh:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--hover); color:var(--text); } .ds-storage-refresh:active:not(:disabled) { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-storage-refresh:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-storage-refresh:disabled { opacity:.48; cursor:default; }

components.name: App identity row
components.description: Flat separated row with neutral monogram and a detail action.
components.html: Updates paused
components.css: .ds-row { display:flex; min-height:94px; align-items:center; gap:20px; padding:21px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size:14px; line-height:1.45; } .ds-identity { display:flex; flex:1; min-width:0; gap:14px; align-items:center; text-align:left; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:none; padding:0; color:var(--text); font:inherit; cursor:pointer; } .ds-identity>span:last-child { display:grid; min-width:0; gap:4px; } .ds-identity strong { overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-identity small { color:var(--secondary); font-size:11px; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-monogram { width:44px; height:44px; flex:0 0 44px; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:10px; background:var(--inset); color:var(--secondary); font-size:21px; font-weight:500; } .ds-status { color:var(--secondary); font-size:12px; max-width:160px; } .ds-identity:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
Relay is a quiet native utility: warm neutral surfaces, system typography, fine separators, and compact blue actions. App identity, current state, and the next action carry the hierarchy.

Light, dark, and system appearance use the same semantic roles and synchronize the native window theme with the resolved appearance. Neutral monograms and Lucide line icons keep the interface practical; no generated imagery is needed.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutrals with restrained blue actions.
Native typography, visible focus, and reduced motion.

rules.name: Semantic appearance
rules.body: Use semantic CSS variables so controls, text, and surfaces change together with appearance.

rules.name: Layer depth
rules.body: Keep ordinary content flat. Reserve broad shadows for temporary layers.

dos: Do keep action labels direct and show each current state once.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, labelled controls, live progress, cancellation, and reduced motion.
Do keep long names, paths, and errors readable through wrapping, detail access, or scrolling.
Do use the existing system type stack, neutral monograms, and Lucide line icons.
donts: Don't add slogans, redundant descriptions, permanent engineering caveats, or unsupported claims.
Don't add a sidebar, search bar, global Activity view, category navigation, or repeated Add app controls to the desktop utility.
Don't use color alone for status or make ordinary rows into floating cards.
